title: Soul Snack #10: How do I change the way I process energy?
excerpt: In today’s soul snack, Gary Zukav introduces a powerful message from his beloved spiritual partner, Linda Francis.
bodyHtml:
In today’s soul snack, Gary Zukav introduces a powerful message from his beloved spiritual partner, Linda Francis. Linda shares transformative insights on shifting from fear to love in your thoughts, words, and actions. 

Drawing on wisdom from the book they co-authored: The Heart of the Soul: Emotional Awareness, Linda answers a listener’s question about consciously processing energy and creating authentic power.

Linda explains how to identify and fully feel the physical sensations of fear-based parts of your personality, while deliberately choosing to act from a loving part of your personality instead. 

By practicing this repeatedly, moment to moment, fear loses its hold over time, allowing you to align your actions with love and your soul’s purpose.

If you’re ready to understand how to change the way energy is processed in your energy processing system in a way that nurtures love and reduces fear, this soul snack is a must-listen!

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:42) Why self-love is foundational to supporting others authentically.
  • (01:16) Recognizing how energy is processed in your body.
  • (02:10) Steps to feel fear fully while acting from love.
  • (03:20) Weakening fear-based parts of your personality over time.
  • (04:00) How conscious intention leads to authentic power.

Soul Step: When fear-based sensations arise in your energy processing centers (e.g., tightness in the throat or chest), pause to fully feel them. Commit to choosing thoughts, words, and actions rooted in love rather than fear. Journal about your experience and observe how your choices impact your interactions.
